Exercise A

Listening: History Bites Podcast

You will hear each recording twice, just like in the real MSA exam. Listen carefully, then answer the questions below — you won't be able to play a recording more than twice.

Part 1 — Podcast Introduction
Part 1 — Comprehension Questions

1 Who first used the phrase "American Dream"?

2 When was the phrase first used?

3 What did Adams describe?

4 What does the Dream mean for many immigrants?

5 Who will the podcast hear from next?

Part 2 — Interview Excerpt
Part 2 — Comprehension Questions

6 What did the Dream mean to Elena when she first arrived?

7 How has Elena's idea of the Dream changed?

8 Does Elena think the Dream is still achievable?

Exercise B

Reading: What the Dream Means & Facts

Read the texts below, then answer the questions — just like Reading Parts 1 and 2 in the real MSA exam.

Part 1 — Match the Person to What the Dream Means to Them

Carlos says: "For me, it's simple: a stable job and enough money to not worry about bills."

Mei says: "I just want my children to have more opportunities than I did."

Robert says: "It's about being able to speak your mind and choose your own path in life."

Aisha says: "After years of feeling like an outsider, I finally feel like this is home."

Part 2 — Did You Know? True or False?

📜 The phrase "American Dream" was first used in 1931.

✍️ James Truslow Adams was a writer and historian, not a politician.

🌍 The American Dream means exactly the same thing to every person.

💪 The idea includes the belief that hard work can lead to success regardless of background.

5 The phrase was first used in 1931.

6 Adams was a politician, not a writer.

7 The Dream means the same thing to everyone.

8 The idea includes the belief that hard work can lead to success.

Exercise C

Writing: Blog Post

Choose ONE of the two prompts below and write 80–100 words, just like Writing Part 3 in the real MSA exam. This section is graded by your teacher, not automatically.

Choose ONE prompt

Prompt 1: What is your opinion about the American Dream? Which aspects do you like or dislike, and why?

Prompt 2: Describe your own personal idea of "success".
